# Light the Night
> Come worship and pray with us. An invite-only worship night on Saturday, October 31, 2026. Doors open 6:00 PM, worship begins 7:00 PM (Central Time).

- Venue: Grand Ballroom, 16th Floor, Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago, 401 N Wabash Ave, Chicago, IL 60611
- Admission: by invitation only; register via Eventbrite (EVENTBRITE_LINK)
- Tickets: each guest receives a personal single-use QR code, scanned once at the door; do not share
- Bring: your Eventbrite ticket QR code (phone or printed)
